# polaris_gcp_regions (Data Source)

The `polaris_gcp_regions` data source returns the GCP regions RSC supports for a
cloud account, each with its availability zones. Use it to discover a valid
`region` and `zone` for the `polaris_gcp_cloud_cluster` resource, and to drive
the `subnet_az_config` blocks of a Multi-AZ cluster with `for_each` over a
region's zones.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SHA-256 hash of the regions returned.
- `regions` (Attributes Set) GCP regions available for the cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Region name, e.g. `us-west1`.
- `zones` (Set of String) Availability zones in the region, e.g. `us-west1-a`.
